# `concept.contract`

[concept](../README.md) · contract

v0.5 NEW core construct (DECISION 0). The agent-facing binding rules for using this concept correctly — the resolution of the framework's deferred 'reasoning_guidance:' question. Absorbs the former *_contract family + no_probe_guarantee + grounding.guarantees. May be a free-text guidance STRING (shorthand) or a structured object with the sub-keys below; all optional.

- [`rules`](#rules) — *list of object*

### `no_probe_guarantee`

*string* · optional

What an agent needs ONLY, to use this concept without probing the data; if more is needed, the concept is incomplete (fix it, don't probe). Was 'no_probe_guarantee'.

Not written by any concept in `contoso5`.

### `resolution`

*['string', 'object']* · optional

How identity / name→code resolves (a join, not a probe). Was name_contract / resolution_contract / identity_contract.

Not written by any concept in `contoso5`.

### `rules`

*list of object* · optional · [has its own keys →](rules/README.md)

v0.1.6: typed behavioural rules (promoted from an applied pilot, FRAMEWORK §6d). Each rule is a trigger->directive, typed by what it governs (kind), and ANCHORED to the field(s) it governs (binds). `binds` must name columns of the table the concept grounds to — enforced cross-file by the rule-binds-grounded shape (mac_shapes.yaml). This is the field-anchoring: a rule cannot claim to govern a field the concept does not ground.

Examples — 14 use(s) in `contoso5`, 14 distinct:

```yaml
# Brand
rules:
- id: brand.resolution.by_grouping_products
  subject: Brand
  kind: mac.concept.rule.resolution
  confidence: P
  scope: CONTOSO5
  binds:
  - brand
  when: the set of products carrying one brand is needed
  then: 'group dim_product on `brand`. The relation is computed — there is no brand table and
    no brand key, so the instance set IS the distinct names on the product row.

    '
  never: 'join to a brand relation

    '
  why: 'none exists, and inventing one gives eleven names a surrogate the warehouse does not have

    '
- id: brand.exclusion.is_not_manufacturer
  subject: Brand
  kind: mac.concept.rule.exclusion
  confidence: P
  scope: CONTOSO5
  binds:
  - brand
  when: a question asks who is behind a product
  then: decide whether it means the brand the customer buys or the manufacturer, and say which
  never: treat the two columns as interchangeable because their member sets overlap

# Color
rules:
- id: color.resolution.by_grouping_products
  subject: Color
  kind: mac.concept.rule.resolution
  confidence: C
  scope: CONTOSO5
  binds:
  - color
  when: the set of products carrying one color is needed
  then: 'group the served `dim_product` on `color`, which already holds one spelling per colour.

    '
  never: 'read `main.product."Color"`, or fold the spellings again at read time — the transform
    did it.

    '
- id: color.ambiguity.blue_is_spelled_twice
  subject: Color
  kind: mac.concept.rule.ambiguity
  confidence: C
  scope: CONTOSO5
  binds:
  - color
  when: a question asks about blue products, or breaks products down by colour
  then: answer over the served `color`, where the two spellings are already one member
  never: 'report `Blue` and `blue` as two colours

    '
  why: 'the landing row spells it two ways and the transform folds it; a breakdown that lists
    both is off by a line, which is what RC03 measured at 17 against an approved 16

    '

# Country
rules:
- id: country.exclusion.sentinel_is_not_a_country
  subject: Country
  kind: mac.concept.rule.exclusion
  confidence: P
  scope: CONTOSO5
  binds:
  - country_code
  never: 'report nine countries

    '
  why: '`--` is the sentinel the source wrote where the online store''s country goes. Counting
    it answers 9 to "in how many countries do we sell" when the truth is 8, and it is the single
    largest "store" in the warehouse, so it dominates any list it is allowed into.

    '
  realized_by:
  - udf: mac.canon.population_select
    params:
      default: real
      populations:
        real:
          all:
          - column: country_code
            op: ne
            value: --
        sentinel:
          all:
          - column: country_code
            op: eq
            value: --
- id: country.default.a_sales_question_means_the_store_country
  subject: Country
  kind: mac.concept.rule.default
  confidence: C
  scope: CONTOSO5
  binds:
  - country_code
  when: 'a measure over sales is grouped by or filtered on a country and the question does not
    say whose country

    '
  then: 'join through the store — `{country_code}` on the store''s row — and say in the answer
    that the figures are by the country the store trades in

    '
  never: 'pick between the store and the customer silently, and never average the two

    '
  why: 'the same word reaches three different relations and the readings are far apart: Germany''s
    2025 growth is +18.07% through the customer and +49.65% through the store, because the store
    path drops the online channel and the online channel is 40% of net revenue. A reader given
    a bare number cannot tell which they got. The operator ruled on 2026-09-30 that both readings
    are legitimate for sales and that the unqualified one is the store; confidence is C because
    a person ruled it.

    '

# … and 11 more distinct value(s)
```
